story.iWant: to browse an inspiration gallery showcasing marble cubes in real settings
story.soThat: I can discover possibilities and find marbles that appeal to me before configuring my own cube

tasks.task: Create gallery route and page structure (AC: #1)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Gallery route `/[locale]/gallery` renders a responsive grid (3-col desktop, 2-col mobile with 24px/16px gaps)
Each gallery card displays high-quality lifestyle image, marble name on hover, "From X €" price, optional use case badge
Featured items appear first with larger card size or special styling via `featured: true` from GalleryItem
Hover animations follow UX spec 6.1: scale 1.02, overlay fade-in, 0.3s ease-out, no animations on mobile
Cards are clickable navigating to `/[locale]/marble/[slug]` with smooth page transition
Loading state shows skeleton shimmer matching card dimensions, no spinners, fade on load

doc.title: Marmorani Architecture
doc.snippet: Server Components by default for SEO/performance. Gallery route at src/app/[locale]/gallery/page.tsx. Image optimization via next/image. Static textures in /public/textures/.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.section: Story 2.3: Inspiration Gallery Page (AC-2.3.1 to AC-2.3.6)
doc.snippet: Gallery page uses Server Components for SEO. GalleryItem model with featured, order fields. MarbleCard with hover overlay per UX spec 6.1. Image optimization 400×400 WebP thumbnails.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Cards: scale(1.02) on hover, opacity 0→1 overlay with 0.3s ease-out. Skeleton shimmer for loading, no spinners. Gold accent #C9A962 for prices. Cormorant Garamond for marble names.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Route: src/app/[locale]/gallery/page.tsx. Components: MarbleCard, MarbleGrid. Loading: skeleton shimmer states. Featured items visually distinguished.

file.reason: Provides type-safe texture path utilities. Use getTextureUrl(slug, 'preview') for gallery thumbnails, getTextureUrl(slug, 'hero') for larger images.
Type definitions for marble data. Extend with GalleryItemLocalized type for gallery display.
Manufacturing constraints and use case categories for gallery filtering context.
Prisma client singleton for database queries.
Layout header with navigation including gallery link.
GalleryItem model: id, marbleId (optional), title/description (JSON multilingual), imageUrl, useCase, featured, order. Relation to Marble for price/slug access.
Translation structure to extend with gallery-specific strings.

constraints.constraint: Use Server Components for gallery page (SEO, performance per ADR-005)
Images via next/image with automatic WebP conversion
Static generation with generateStaticParams for marble detail pages
Component pattern: Props interface → hooks → derived state → handlers → render
Functions: camelCase with verb (getGalleryItems), constants: SCREAMING_SNAKE
Cormorant Garamond for marble names, Inter for body/prices
Gold accent #C9A962 for prices, dark theme transition 0.5s for configurator
Use useTranslations() hook, JSON fields resolved at query time

tests.standards: Testing frameworks: Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E. Location: tests/unit/, tests/components/, tests/e2e/. Pattern: Test files named *.test.ts or *.spec.ts. Coverage: Focus on query functions and component rendering.

devNotes.note: From Story 2-2-marble-texture-assets: - Texture utilities in src/lib/textures.ts ready to use - Use getTextureUrl(slug, 'preview') for 400×400 thumbnails - Use getTextureUrl(slug, 'hero') for 1200×800 images - 10 marble slugs available in MARBLE_SLUGS constant - Format: PNG for 3D textures, JPEG for UI images

/[locale]/gallery (page.tsx - Server Component) ├── GalleryHeader (title, optional filter trigger) ├── Suspense boundary │ └── GalleryGridSkeleton (loading state) └── MarbleGrid └── MarbleCard (× N) ├── next/image (lifestyle photo) ├── HoverOverlay │ ├── MarbleName │ └── PriceIndicator └── Link → /marble/[slug]
"From X €" price = 10×10×10 cm cube × basePricePerCm3 × cheapest finish modifier / 100. Example: basePricePerCm3=50 cents, RAW modifier=0.85 → 1000 × 50 × 0.85 / 100 = 425€
